applicant.name: Dr. Miriam Kogler
applicant.organisation: Austrian Diabetes Quality Network (association of GP practices)

purpose: Quality improvement in diabetes care: we want to know how many patients with type 2 diabetes are poorly controlled in each region, to target GP training.
question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes who have an HbA1c value, how many have a latest HbA1c above 8%, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes who have an HbA1c value, how many of them have an HbA1c above 8, and that share in %, one decimal.
